name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard is the commanded key grab and is lone, so it needs its own hard clause. Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard keeps the 'after that' order, which sits outside the 'if you can' cue. Existence(at_goal) soft matches the preference for the goal, and the machine gives it a reward effect.

texts: Grab the key (the agent must end up carrying the yellow key at some point).
After grabbing the key, the agent gets to the goal square; the goal is reached only after the key is held.
Get to the goal square after that, if the agent can (preferred, not required).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 7
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -100.839
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 12
